title: Blog post predicting that within a decade we will acknowledge non-human intelligence

tellings.quote: i think that we're going to be stay in a decade from now where we acknowledge that we are not the only life forms that are intelligent and super intelligent on this planet

plain: Within about ten years, humanity will admit that we are not the only intelligent, even super intelligent, life on this planet. That is the prediction Deep Prasad, a young researcher, says he set down in a blog post called Curiosity as a Time Capsule, and he repeats it to Jesse Michels in 2022. If he is right, such an admission would come by around 2032.
